title: User input

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Console and form input start as text; check empty or malformed values before converting to a number.
CORE EXPLANATION
input()
reads text from the user and returns str. Convert the value to the required type before numeric calculations.
EXAMPLE CODE
QUESTION: What will this code print? Predict first, then run it.

spans.code:
from unittest.mock import patch

with patch('builtins.input', return_value='20'):
    age_text = input('Age: ')
age = int(age_text)
print(age + 1)

spans.title: Watch out
spans.text: A regex does not make input safe for SQL, HTML, or a URL; use context-appropriate escaping or parameters.
COMMON MISTAKES
String methods return transformed text rather than changing the original; a regex checks only the pattern you specify.
